Name: Move the Graveyard Fence
Author: Regnander
Description:
[i][b]Note: This mod has only been tested on local multiplayer.[/b][/i]

Tired of bumping into the fence when traveling past the graveyard on your way to the beach? This mod will move the entire fence one tile to the left.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Known issues[/size]
The lantern beside the right-most gravestone gets placed on top of the fence.
